subject.title: [Bug]: Code Mode rejects ordinary import/require methods and misses direct loader variants

question: Should maintainers sponsor a focused AST-based Code Mode validator repair that treats only executable direct module-loader references as forbidden while retaining ordinary `import` and `require` object members?
rationale: The report concerns the boundary that prevents module access from entering the QuickJS guest, and the intended syntax coverage must be chosen deliberately rather than inferred from a regular-expression patch.

options.title: Sponsor AST-based repair
options.body: Adopt syntax-node inspection for JavaScript and TypeScript and require parser plus worker regressions for member access and all reported loader-call spellings.

options.title: Narrow the supported syntax
options.body: Document a narrower Code Mode language subset if maintainers intentionally want to reject some otherwise-valid `import` or `require` member syntax.

recommendation.title: Sponsor AST-based repair
recommendation.body: Adopt syntax-node inspection for JavaScript and TypeScript and require parser plus worker regressions for member access and all reported loader-call spellings.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporter supplied the concrete behavior matrix and proposed repair boundary; repository history attribution remains incomplete.
